cells.gaps: Staged on the mainland (RITA); Zanzibar's eCRVS runs in all 11 districts with no count of offices (TZA-003), and a 2025 paper calls it primarily paper-based (TZA-007). The 57% is centres RITA counts as active, the inactive ones lacking the phone that uploads, not a stated count of centres entering digitally; TZA-017 says some centres' registrations are keyed by district officers, and the newer TZA-011 (12,025 points, 2025) gives no total and no number entering digitally. Inside the 36 months no domestic finance fact is held (TZA-025 is 2018) and the plan in TZA-014 ran to 2025/26, ending June 2026; the only event inside the twelve months is Zanzibar's (TZA-005), the mainland's being October 2024.
cells.note: Coverage reaches stage 4: births entered at the centre by phone into the central system (TZA-010, TZA-016) at 6,341 of 11,053 centres (TZA-019). The cap holds it at 3 because, inside the window, governance shows the owner but neither a domestic budget line nor a plan whose period includes the as-at.
